checks.criterion: Installer is not shown as available before it is published
checks.name: owner-devices-download-unavailable
checks.evidence: Logged in as proprio@bastille.fr, /dashboard/imprimantes shows devices-download-unavailable notice, devices-download-agent button has count 0. Confirmed via curl: GET /api/agent-download -> {"available":false,...} for release version 0.2.0, no url, no hosted file.

checks.criterion: Super-admin publishes the installer on printdrop.fr
checks.name: superadmin-publish-installer-and-shop-downloads
checks.evidence: Logged in as printdrop35@gmail.com, uploaded synthetic MZ+'Inno Setup'+>1MB file named PrintDrop-Setup-0.4.0.exe via agent-installer-upload input; agent-installer-info appeared showing v0.4.0 hosted. Then as owner, /dashboard/imprimantes showed devices-download-agent containing '0.4.0' plus devices-download-meta (size/SHA).

checks.criterion: Super-admin publishes/removes the installer; invalid files refused; shop downloads exact bytes; shop cannot publish
checks.name: test_tscheck_agent_installer_upload.py::test_installer_lifecycle_publish_download_remove
checks.evidence: pytest: POST /admin/agent-release/upload with non-MZ, MZ-without-marker, and <1MB files -> 422 each, release unchanged; valid MZ+'Inno Setup'+1MB+500B file named PrintDrop-Setup-0.4.0.exe -> 200, version=0.4.0, url=/api/agent-download/file, sha256 64 hex matching hashlib.sha256(data). Owner POST upload / DELETE file -> 403. GET /agent-download/file as owner returned exact bytes with Content-Disposition containing PrintDrop-Setup-0.4.0.exe; anonymous GET /agent-download and /agent-download/file -> 401. DELETE /admin/agent-release/file -> 200, filename=='', subsequent owner GET /agent-download/file -> 404, available=false. Release restored to version 0.2.0 in finally block (verified by curl after run).

checks.evidence: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q -> 63 passed in 30.02s (62 pre-existing + 1 new test_tscheck_agent_installer_upload.py).
